proposal.summary: A Linux kernel flaw in tls_is_tx_ready() improperly checks list emptiness, which can lead to accessing a type-confused list_head entry and leaking the last byte of a confused field that overlaps rec->tx_ready.
proposal.cwe_quote: tls_is_tx_ready() incorrectly checks for list emptiness, potentially accessing a type confused entry to the list_head, leaking the last byte of the confused field that overlaps with rec->tx_ready.

AV.quote: A flaw was found in the Linux Kernel.

S.quote: leaking the last byte of the confused field that overlaps with rec->tx_ready.

C.quote: leaking the last byte of the confused field that overlaps with rec->tx_ready.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the full vulnerability report or commit diff and reproduce to confirm the code path; backport and deploy the upstream kernel patch that fixes tls_is_tx_ready() list emptiness check; notify downstream kernel maintainers and include a test that prevents type-confused list_head access.
